species.real: The Roman palace at Fishbourne, near Chichester, has some of the finest mosaics in Britain, including Cupid riding a dolphin.
species.name: Tesserite

dex.text: A walking mosaic of small coloured stones, which arrange themselves into a face when you look at it and a pattern of partridges when you look away. It is two thousand years old and it still hasn't lost a tile.
dex.fact: A tessera is one of the small cubes of stone, glass or tile used to make a mosaic. The House of Eustolios at Kourion, in the Akrotiri Sovereign Base Area, has floors of tesserae laid in the early Christian period, with birds, fish and a Greek inscription.
